Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on your itinerary from June 10-20, 2024:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days at Waikiki and Kailua, snorkeling at Hanauma Bay)
- Sunscreen (high SPF recommended for Hawaii's strong sun)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike on June 13)
- Casual outfits (for daily activities and the Luau on June 16)
- Camera (to capture memories at Pearl Harbor, North Shore, etc.)
- Travel documents (passport/ID, hotel confirmations, flight details)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Light rain jacket (for potential showers)
- Reef-safe sunscreen (required for Hawaii beaches)
- Water shoes (for snorkeling and beach activities)
- Hat and sunglasses (for sun protection during outdoor activities)
- Reusable water bottle (stay hydrated during hikes and outdoor activities)
- Beach towel
- Flip flops/sandals
- Formal attire (if needed for any special dinners)
- Medications and first aid supplies
- Power bank for phone/camera
- Snorkel gear (optional, can also rent at Hanauma Bay)

Special Notes:
- Pack light layers as temperatures are warm but can vary
- Bring appropriate footwear for the Diamond Head hike on June 13
- Don't forget your spa outfit for the relaxation day on June 17
